name: EverValueCoin
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.95). Replaced keyword guess "logic-error".

descriptions.text: EverValueCoin's orderbook contract (0x03339E...80A0) let a caller submit an order via addNewOrder(pairId, quantity, price, isBuy, timestamp) with an attacker-chosen price and timestamp, and this self-asserted price was used to value the EVA/WBTC pair without validation against a trustworthy market source. The attacker took a 1,200 WBTC-unit (1200000000) flash loan from Morpho Blue, placed a large buy order at a manipulated price to mint/obtain a huge amount of EVA cheaply, then dumped that EVA for WBTC across two Uniswap V3 routers (the EVA/WBTC 1% fee pool). The proceeds repaid the Morpho flash loan and left the attacker with roughly 100k USD of profit, an arbitrage made possible solely by the unvalidated price input in the orderbook.
